analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the Financial Year 2025-26, convening its 34th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. The document details administrative procedures for remote e-voting and video conferencing participation through NSDL. It also includes notices and explanatory statements for the re-appointment of directors, including Mr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah as an Independent Director and Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan as a Whole-time Director.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that there is a surge in AI adoption among small businesses globally, with about 68% of small business owners already using AI.
demand_outlook.quote: About 68% of small business owners report already using AI, up sharply from 51% just two years prior.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that an additional 9% of small business owners plan to begin using AI within the next year.
demand_outlook.quote: An additional 9% plan to begin using AI within the next year, indicating that roughly three-quarters of small firms will soon be AI-powered.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that dSpeedUp's digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants with a 95% annual client retention rate.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited industry survey data indicating that 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: These efforts were aimed at closing the “resource and information gap” noted in industry surveys (e.g. 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: The company scheduled its 34th Annual General Meeting to be held on Tuesday, September 29, 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed that Calsofts remains dedicated to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, Calsofts remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs, ensuring that innovation is not just for the few, but for the many.
